sections.title: 1. Description
sections.text_preview: The reference deployment application is to demonstrate a collection of ISF components interconnected to form a deployment. The deployment represents a "reference" spacecraft that includes commanding,

sections.title: 2. Topology
sections.text_preview: The topology of the reference example is the interconnection of all the components used in the reference deployment (a deployment is a set of components connected together and compiled into a binary).

sections.title: 2.1 Commanding
sections.text_preview: The commanding view consists of connections for components to register commands, the dispatching of commands and the return of command execution status.

sections.text_preview:

sections.text_preview:

![Reference Commanding](img/ibd__Ref__REF_Commanding.jpg)

sections.title: 2.2 Telemetry
sections.text_preview: The telemetry view consists of connections for components to update telemetry channels in the `TlmChan` component.

sections.title: 2.2.1 C&DH Telemetry
sections.text_preview:
The connections for the C&DH telemetry are as follows:

sections.text_preview:
The connections for the reference deployment telemetry are as follows:

![Reference Telemetry](img/ibd__Ref__REF_Telemetry.jpg)

sections.title: 2.3 Logging
sections.text_preview: The logging view consists of connections for components to send events for logging to the `EventManager` component.

sections.title: 2.4 Parameters
sections.text_preview: The parameters view consists of connections for components to retrieve and update parameters stored in the `PrmDb` component.

sections.title: 2.3.1 C&DH Parameters
sections.text_preview: The core C&DH components do not have any parameters.

![Reference Parameters](img/ibd__Ref__Parameters.jpg)

sections.title: 2.5 Time
sections.text_preview: The time view consists of connections for components to get time for time-tagging events and telemetry.

![Reference Time](img/ibd__Ref__REF_Time.jpg)

sections.title: 2.6 Health
sections.text_preview: The health view consists of connections for components to respond to pings from `Health`to verify their threads are alive.

sections.text_preview:
The connections for the reference deployment health are as follows:

![Reference Health](img/ibd__Ref__REF_Health.jpg)
